description: This file implements the ControlService class, which manages control connections, handles application state changes, and performs ping operations within the Rialto media server component. It interacts with control server internals, heartbeat procedures, and logging facilities.

classes.name: ControlService
classes.description: A class responsible for managing control sessions, handling control commands, application state, and heartbeat pings within the Rialto server.

methods.name: ControlService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ControlService with factory dependencies and setting initial state.

methods.name: addControl
methods.description: Creates and registers a new control session with a specified control ID and client.

methods.name: removeControl
methods.description: Removes a control session identified by control ID.

methods.name: ack
methods.description: Acknowledges a control message with a specific ID for a given control session.

methods.name: setApplicationState
methods.description: Updates the application state and propagates it to all control sessions.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Performs a heartbeat ping to all control sessions using a heartbeat procedure.
